    '};\n' +
    '\n' +
    'function delay(milliseconds: number): Promise<void> {\n' +
    '  return new Promise((resolve) => window.setTimeout(resolve, milliseconds));\n' +
    '}\n' +
    '\n' +
    'function errorFrom(value: unknown): Error | null {\n' +
    '  if (!value) return null;\n' +
    '  if (value instanceof Error) return value;\n' +
    '  if (typeof value === "object" && value !== null && "message" in value) {\n' +
    '    const message = (value as { message?: unknown }).message;\n' +
    '    if (typeof message === "string" && message.trim()) return new Error(message);\n' +
    '  }\n' +
    '  return new Error(String(value));\n' +
    '}\n' +
    '\n' +
    'function stableKey(value: unknown): string {\n' +
    '  const seen = new WeakSet<object>();\n' +
    '  try {\n' +
    '    return JSON.stringify(value, (_key, nested) => {\n' +
    '      if (!nested || typeof nested !== "object") return nested;\n' +
    '      if (seen.has(nested)) return "[circular]";\n' +
    '      seen.add(nested);\n' +
    '      if (Array.isArray(nested)) return nested;\n' +
    '      return Object.keys(nested as Record<string, unknown>)\n' +
    '        .sort()\n' +
    '        .reduce<Record<string, unknown>>((result, key) => {\n' +
    '          result[key] = (nested as Record<string, unknown>)[key];\n' +
    '          return result;\n' +
    '        }, {});\n' +
    '    });\n' +
    '  } catch {\n' +
    '    return "unkeyed";\n' +
    '  }\n' +

    '\n' +
    'function withFriendlyEvidenceError(result: InvokeResult): InvokeResult {\n' +

    '  if (!error || !GENERIC_FUNCTION_ERROR.test(error.message)) return result;\n' +
    '\n' +
    '  return {\n' +
    '    ...result,\n' +
    '    error: new Error(\n' +
    '      "Secure evidence could not be refreshed. Tap refresh to try again.",\n' +
    '    ),\n' +
    '  };\n' +

    '\n' +
    'function withTimeout<T>(\n' +
    '  request: Promise<T>,\n' +
    '  evidenceName: string,\n' +
    '  cancel?: () => void,\n' +
    '): Promise<T> {\n' +
    '  return new Promise<T>((resolve, reject) => {\n' +
    '    const timeoutId = window.setTimeout(() => {\n' +
    '      cancel?.();\n' +
    '      reject(new Error(`${evidenceName} evidence request timed out`));\n' +
    '    }, REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS);\n' +
    '\n' +
    '    request.then(\n' +
    '      (result) => {\n' +
    '        window.clearTimeout(timeoutId);\n' +
    '        resolve(result);\n' +
    '      },\n' +
    '      (error: unknown) => {\n' +
    '        window.clearTimeout(timeoutId);\n' +
    '        reject(error);\n' +
    '      },\n' +
    '    );\n' +
    '  });\n' +
    '}\n' +
    '\n' +
    'async function retryTransientEvidence(\n' +
    '  evidenceName: string,\n' +
    '  request: (attempt: number) => Promise<InvokeResult>,\n' +
    '): Promise<InvokeResult> {\n' +
    '  let lastThrownError: Error | null = null;\n' +
    '  let lastResult: InvokeResult | null = null;\n' +
    '\n' +
    '  for (let attempt = 0; attempt < MAX_ATTEMPTS; attempt += 1) {\n' +
    '    const startedAt = performance.now();\n' +
    '    try {\n' +
    '      const result = await request(attempt);\n' +
    '      const resultError = errorFrom(result?.error);\n' +
    '      if (!resultError) {\n' +
    '        telemetry(evidenceName, attempt + 1, "success", Math.round(performance.now() - startedAt));\n' +
    '        return result;\n' +
    '      }\n' +
    '\n' +
    '      lastResult = result;\n' +
    '      if (!TRANSIENT_MESSAGE.test(resultError.message) || attempt === MAX_ATTEMPTS - 1) {\n' +
    '        telemetry(evidenceName, attempt + 1, "failed", Math.round(performance.now() - startedAt));\n' +
    '        return withFriendlyEvidenceError(result);\n' +
    '      }\n' +
    '      telemetry(evidenceName, attempt + 1, "retry", Math.round(performance.now() - startedAt));\n' +
    '    } catch (error) {\n' +
    '      const currentError = errorFrom(error) ?? new Error(`${evidenceName} evidence request failed`);\n' +
    '      lastThrownError = currentError;\n' +
    '      const timedOut = /timed out|aborted/i.test(currentError.message);\n' +
    '      if (!TRANSIENT_MESSAGE.test(currentError.message) || attempt === MAX_ATTEMPTS - 1) {\n' +
    '        telemetry(\n' +
    '          evidenceName,\n' +
    '          attempt + 1,\n' +
    '          timedOut ? "timeout" : "failed",\n' +
    '          Math.round(performance.now() - startedAt),\n' +
    '        );\n' +
    '        throw currentError;\n' +
    '      }\n' +
    '      telemetry(\n' +
    '        evidenceName,\n' +
    '        attempt + 1,\n' +
    '        timedOut ? "timeout" : "retry",\n' +
    '        Math.round(performance.now() - startedAt),\n' +
    '      );\n' +
    '    }\n' +
    '\n' +
    '    await delay(250 * (attempt + 1));\n' +
    '  }\n' +
    '\n' +
    '  if (lastResult) return withFriendlyEvidenceError(lastResult);\n' +
    '  throw lastThrownError ?? new Error(`${evidenceName} evidence could not be loaded`);\n' +
    '}\n' +
    '\n' +
    'function deduplicated(\n' +
    '  key: string,\n' +
    '  request: () => Promise<InvokeResult>,\n' +
    '): Promise<InvokeResult> {\n' +
    '  const current = inFlightEvidence.get(key);\n' +
    '  if (current) return current;\n' +
    '\n' +
    '  const next = request().finally(() => {\n' +
    '    if (inFlightEvidence.get(key) === next) inFlightEvidence.delete(key);\n' +
    '  });\n' +
    '  inFlightEvidence.set(key, next);\n' +
    '  return next;\n' +
    '}\n' +
    '\n' +
    'function installFunctionResilience(): void {\n' +
    '  const functions = supabase.functions as FunctionsClient;\n' +
    '  if (functions[FUNCTIONS_INSTALL_MARKER]) return;\n' +
    '\n' +
    '  const invoke = functions.invoke.bind(functions) as (\n' +
    '    functionName: string,\n' +
    '    options?: InvokeOptions,\n' +
    '  ) => Promise<InvokeResult>;\n' +
    '\n' +
    '  functions.invoke = (async (\n' +
    '    functionName: string,\n' +
    '    options?: InvokeOptions,\n' +
    '  ): Promise<InvokeResult> => {\n' +
    '    if (!EVIDENCE_FUNCTIONS.has(functionName)) {\n' +
    '      return invoke(functionName, options);\n' +
    '    }\n' +
    '\n' +
    '    const key = `function:${functionName}:${stableKey(options?.body ?? null)}`;\n' +
    '    return deduplicated(key, () =>\n' +
    '      retryTransientEvidence(functionName, () => {\n' +
    '        const controller = new AbortController();\n' +
    '        const requestOptions = {\n' +
    '          ...(options ?? {}),\n' +
    '          signal: controller.signal,\n' +
    '        } as InvokeOptions;\n' +
    '        return withTimeout(\n' +
    '          invoke(functionName, requestOptions),\n' +
    '          functionName,\n' +
    '          () => controller.abort(),\n' +
    '        );\n' +
    '      }),\n' +
    '    );\n' +
    '  }) as typeof functions.invoke;\n' +
    '\n' +
    '  functions[FUNCTIONS_INSTALL_MARKER] = true;\n' +
    '}\n' +
    '\n' +
    'function installRpcResilience(): void {\n' +
    '  const client = supabase as unknown as RpcClient;\n' +
    '  if (client[RPC_INSTALL_MARKER]) return;\n' +
    '\n' +
    '  const rpc = client.rpc.bind(client);\n' +
    '  client.rpc = (\n' +
    '    functionName: string,\n' +
    '    parameters?: Record<string, unknown>,\n' +
    '    options?: Record<string, unknown>,\n' +

    '    if (!EVIDENCE_RPCS.has(functionName)) {\n' +
    '      return rpc(functionName, parameters, options);\n' +
    '    }\n' +
    '\n' +
    '    const key = `rpc:${functionName}:${stableKey(parameters ?? null)}`;\n' +

    '      retryTransientEvidence(functionName, () =>\n' +
    '        withTimeout(\n' +
    '          Promise.resolve(rpc(functionName, parameters, options)) as Promise<InvokeResult>,\n' +
    '          functionName,\n' +
    '        ),\n' +
    '      ),\n' +
    '    );\n' +
    '  };\n' +
    '\n' +
    '  client[RPC_INSTALL_MARKER] = true;\n' +
    '}\n' +
    '\n' +
    'function installLiveEvidenceResilience(): void {\n' +
    '  if (typeof window === "undefined") return;\n' +
    '  installFunctionResilience();\n' +
    '  installRpcResilience();\n' +
    '}\n' +
    '\n' +
    'installLiveEvidenceResilience();\n',
